dedupe_keys.name: ine chile censo 2024 dwelling basic services by comuna water source distribution sanitation electricity source waste disposal

description: Chile's National Statistics Institute published, on 30 May 2025, the third release of results from the 2024 Population and Housing Census, including a workbook of ten tables on the basic services of dwellings. For the country, each region and each comuna it counts occupied private dwellings with residents present by source of domestic water, water distribution system, sanitation system, source of electricity and means of waste disposal. Coverage is national: of 6,408,172 such dwellings, 5,914,136 take water from the public network and 131,141 from water trucks, 6,316,147 draw electricity from the public grid, 32,343 from solar panels and 24,917 have none, and 6,221,171 have municipal waste collection. Comuna rows carry official region, province and comuna codes. Companion workbooks on the same page give dwellings and households counted, dwelling characteristics and irrecoverable dwellings, bedrooms and overcrowding, household services and tenure, and dwelling types. Format and access: free XLSX downloads, no registration; Redatam web serves the 2017, 2002 and 1992 census microdata. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 under the INE open data terms. Caveats: counts are for occupied dwellings with residents present only; the block-level census database announced in December 2025 was not located on the pages read. Simulation uses: comuna gaps in grid electricity, piped water and waste collection for service planning, and off-grid solar and generator counts for resilience studies. Related records: the SUBTEL Chile telecom statistics series and the RETC Chile waste open data.
